Choynak yon tomoniga kamera aylanadi, texnik yorliq koʻrinadi, lekin yozuvi oʻqilmaydi.
Choynak stolda statik holatda, yoritish materiali va silliqligini koʻrsatadi.

result.promptEn: This video showcases a gray electric kettle as the sole visual authority. The product's exact silhouette, gray color, and visible handle must remain unchanged. The technical label on the side is visible but the text remains unreadable and is not emphasized. Start with a soft-lit, clean studio environment showing a frontal view of the kettle with its handle. The camera slowly pushes in to highlight the kettle's smooth surface and matte material. Next, the camera gently pans right to reveal the kettle's side, showing the technical label without focusing on the text. Finally, a static shot from a tripod presents the kettle set on a plain surface emphasizing the material texture and shape. The environment should be bright but neutral, with lighting that reveals the real color and finish without glare or reflections. No additional text or branding is present. The audio consists of subtle room tone and light ambient foley matched to small background sounds like soft clicks or chair movement. The video runs for 8 seconds with three simple beats and transitions consisting of smooth cuts and camera movement. The product remains dominant and clearly visible throughout. Avoid any invented markings, colors, or designs. Do not show any internal parts or fluid inside the kettle. Avoid busy backgrounds or distracting elements to maintain a clean studio look. The camera movement remains controlled and natural, no fast or energetic motions. The final product presentation emphasizes the kettle's practical and simple design, appealing to family-oriented buyers.
